note: BH-9435: free MB on / at build start under which the headroom step (bin/lib/rb/gates.d/disk-headroom.sh, right above the disk gate) trims old settled build dirs (their subdirs go; the dir and its top-level files stay), oldest first, until free >= this value. 0 turns the step off (the build-start measure line is still written). Per project: lane.disk-guard.<project>.disk_headroom_min_free_mb.
